title: Rational Constant Snapping within 1% Tolerance
problem: Raw regression yields arbitrary floating point constants like 0.0498721 which inflate description length without physical basis.
solution: Snap to clean rationals {0, +-1, +-0.5, +-0.05, +-1.5}. Accept snapped constant if worst-case error delta <= 1.0%.
lesson: Simplicity and compression improve held-out out-of-distribution generalization.
